source.note: Kept from the source: what each kind means when it judges a roll (same, different, run, even, odd, at least, face, sum, max, spread, two pair). New here: patterns as plain data compiled to the test dice-odds and dice-tray take, ops on sum, max, spread and count, all and any, and the smallest-set rule (the source joined each condition's smallest set and read every die for a sum; here it is the fewest dice that meet the whole pattern on their own, or with whole only when every die together meets it).
